name: UAbilitySystemComponent::HandleGameplayEvent
notes: Walks the tag and its parents (retrying with the parent tag when no match). Invokes the generic gameplay-event callbacks (+0x538 array) and the event-triggered abilities (+0x798 table) for the tag with the payload. Full body read (337 lines). Callback predicate 0x140712f30 is read in full and named by role (trigger gate). Tag lookup 0x143e967c0 is named by role (gameplay tag manager lookup).
